text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: At the Fan Fest, an overly excited Haru Urara competes in a variety of different racing events.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huff… huff… huff… the tire pull is finally over!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: And, and… I came in last!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, right, right. That tire was sooo heavy!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I lost in the bunny hop, carrot picking, and pipe rolling too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: But…

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara just keeps losing. Shouldn't she just call it quits?

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: How dare you say that! Urara never gives up!

text_block_list.name: Kind Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Urara! You can do it!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Yeah, there's still hope! Keep going!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Y-yeah! Give it your best shot, Haru Urara!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow! Everyone's cheering even harder than before! But I'm losing… So why?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Every time Haru Urara appears at an event, the crowd goes wild. They love watching her unrelenting drive to keep going no matter how many times she loses.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: If I win now, I'm sure they'll be even happier!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm great at the mud run, so I'm sure I'll win!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Now onto the Fan Fest's main event, the mud run! The Umamusume will have to run through thick muck!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text: Oh! Haru Urara is off with a bang! Looks like she still has plenty of energy left after all those events! It seems like she's taking an early lead! Let's see how that plays out for her!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: URARARARARA!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Nooo! Last again! My plan to take the lead as a front runner was a huge failure!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I'm sure my fans are all disappointed…

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Awww, that was so close too! You'll get it next time for sure!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Show us more of that classic Urara spunk!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: What?! They're cheering even louder!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: They…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: They're looking forward to seeing my next race! Then I gotta do my best!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I was gonna take a break, but never mind! I need to find another event to join!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Daaash!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: No matter how plucky Haru Urara may be, it's not good if she pushes herself too hard. I rush over and finally manage to slow her down…

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yaaaay! I did it! I got first!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: That mud was so heavy, so I decided to sprint right out the gates!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I figured running super fast is just as tiring as running with stuff weighing me down!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: So then I ran and ran and ran. It was exhausting, but I gave it my all!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Yeah! Heeheehee! Guess I became my own trainer there!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara has ended her losing streak! Her efforts finally paid off!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Show us that fighting spirit in the next race, too!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow! Look how happy they all are! Heehee, I'm glad I tried so hard!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I promise I won't lose, so please come and watch my future races!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara shows the audience the fruits of her labor and is rewarded with a pumped-up crowd!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After the event, Haru Urara has a meet-and-greet with her fans.

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: Urara, you like carrots, right? Here you go!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wow, really? Yay! Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Child
text_block_list.text: My mom told me not to give you snacks, but this is okay, right?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: She did? I'm sure it's fine!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Heehee… You can give me as many snacks as you want!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch Haru Urara spending time with her fans, I hear some voices talking behind me.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Haru Urara is so popular. Makes sense, she's really cute…

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: She said she wants to compete in the Arima Kinen. She's sure to make it in, given how popular she is.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: What?! There's no way! She may be cute, but she isn't that good.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text: Well, I heard there's a fan vote. As long as she gets enough votes, there's a chance.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: A vote, huh? I'd probably vote for her. She's just so cute!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A fan vote? That's definitely one way to increase our chances, but…

text_block_list.name: Energetic Shopkeeper
text_block_list.text: Oooh, so there is a way! I've got to tell the others!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I recognize the shopkeeper as part of Haru Urara's fan club. I open my mouth to say something, but they're already gone.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Trainer! They want a group picture!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Can you give us a countdown and take the picture?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: All in all, the fans are overjoyed with Haru Urara's performance. The Fan Fest was a huge success!
